syllabify_norm.note: content-based degenerate: naive CV/CVC syllabification of the normalized form, no training data

lemma_most_common.note: most frequent training spelling of the lemma (ignores inflection)

lemma_by_period.note: as above but conditioned on the text period (metadata probe)

stem_suffix_adversary.note: nearest attested spelling of the lemma by normalized prefix, syllabified remainder appended; uses exactly the attested column
